_meta.warning: Warframe's meta shifts every few months (new frames, new Arcane systems, weapon rework waves like Incarnon Genesis). This seed is intentionally small and general-direction rather than exhaustive — see README for why. Treat 'confidence: directional' entries as a starting point to verify, not a finished optimal build.
_meta.source_note: Mod/ability direction synthesized from general Warframe knowledge and a July 2026 web search across multiple independent tier-list/build-guide sites; no single build list was copied verbatim from any source.

builds.name: Iron Skin Tank
builds.notes: Iron Skin absorbs damage scaling with armor and Ability Strength; this fundamental hasn't changed in years. Long-stable pick for a first Steel Path tank.

builds.name: Speed / Shield Support
builds.notes: Squad speed buff plus Shock/Discharge utility. Core loop is unchanged structurally, but check current Arcane options — Arcane slotting for exalted/ability builds expanded significantly in 2026 and may be worth pairing here.

builds.name: Spores / Miasma Nuke
builds.notes: Range + Strength focused so Spores procs spread and Miasma's armor strip covers a wide area. Multiple independent 2026 sources still rank Saryn S-tier for this exact loop, unusually stable pick despite several balance passes over the years.

builds.name: Peacemaker Exalted Crit
builds.notes: 2026 sources consistently point to Mesa's exalted secondary benefiting heavily from weapon-slot Arcanes now — that part of her kit is Arcane-dependent enough that I'd verify current Arcane options before finalizing rather than trust an exact mod list from me.

builds.name: Reservoirs Support
builds.notes: Squad-wide buff reservoirs (health/speed/damage) plus strong mobility and self-survivability. Consistently ranked as a top support pick through 2026 — role and core kit are stable, exact mod slots less critical than getting all three reservoir types down.

builds.name: Overguard Nuke/Support
builds.notes: 2026 sources describe Dante as reshaping squad play via Overguard generation, built around Ability Strength and Duration, and note he performs well without needing Helminth changes. I have lower confidence in the exact mod slots here than the notes suggest for the ability direction — Dante released after my training cutoff, so verify this one more than the others.
